data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'munshid' meaning 'singer' or 'melodist'. This name holds great significance in Islamic culture, as music is considered a form of worship and expression of faith. The name Munshidah carries the meaning “Singer, Melodist” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munshidah usually hope their child will grow to embody singer, melodist and live with faith, good character and purpose.
